description: Change a design or the user's own photo in plain words: make the subject bigger, add a short text, a name or a date, add a frame, change colours or remove something. Use this for every change to a design (never regenerate the image yourself), then create_proof. Only that change is made. Creates a new design; the original is kept. Takes about 45 seconds.

product.description: Product reference it will be printed on; the result then gets the shape of that product (e.g. wide for a mug), with text inside the printed area
product.title: Product

real_subject.description: Only for a real, existing building, monument, bridge, windmill, church or recognisable place the user names: its name and town, e.g. 'Poldertoren Emmeloord'. The engine looks up a photo of it and draws the real one. Not for the user's own house, pet or people: ask for a photo.
real_subject.title: Real Subject

reference_photo.description: Design id of a photo the user uploaded that shows what the subject really looks like (their dog, their house, or a photo of the building)
reference_photo.title: Reference Photo

name: edit_design
title: Edit design
